source.method: Static SWF tag parsing, AVM1 literal/constant-pool instruction decoding, and signed-relative-branch resolution only. No SWF, AVM1, ActionScript or game execution.
source.offsetUnit: Decimal absolute byte offset in the supplied uncompressed SWF.

parameters.boundaryBehavior: Candidate axis is assigned only if strictly within its open range. It is not clamped to either endpoint.

worldBackdrop.relationship: Inside gameworld; inherits gameworld transform. No separate city-half-speed root placement at a3.

initialCoordinateAnalysis.method: Arithmetic substitution of authored positions into decoded load expressions; no runtime execution or observation.
initialCoordinateAnalysis.caveat: Does not simulate ordering among first-frame/load/enterFrame events, player boundary logic, held inputs, saved state, or other runtime writes. Authored placement, arithmetic load-result, and observed first playable frame are different claims.
